1. Load libraries
```{r}
# Load Library
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)  
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)

```

2. Load data
```{r}
data <- read_excel("~/GitHub/VirosporeQuant/SPO1_mutant/Data//20260917_0011_annulus_test.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
```

3. Account for the dilutions performed and the stock
```{r}
# Calculate vPFU of the original suspension which is # of PFU or CFU / vol plated x total dilution factor
#data$vPFU_mL_2 <- data$vPFU_10e2/ (0.1 * (10^-2))
# No need to perform the above with the new data, there was no dilution performed in the new data (20260917)

# Calculate vPFU per mL (plated 0.1 mL and did not dilute sample)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    vPFU.ml = vPFU * 10
  )
# Accounting for the stock amount (the amount of liquid that the virospores were deposited into in mL)
#data$vPFU_stock <- data$vPFU_mL_2 * 0.1
```

4. Account for the area sampled 
```{r}
# Calculate per area for virospores
data$vPFU_cm2 <- data$vPFU.ml / (0.00785)
```

5. Plot via box plot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
data$Genotype <- factor(data$Genotype, levels = c("wildtype", "mutant"))
# boxplot of vPFU_cm2 grouped by Genotype

ggplot(data, aes(x = Genotype, y = vPFU_cm2, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(scales::hue_pal()(2))) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) + # add points
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "vPFU per cm²"
  ) 

# Making the plot better
ggplot(data, aes(x = Genotype, y = vPFU_cm2, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(scales::hue_pal()(2))) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Virospores per cm²"
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20)),
    labels = scales::label_scientific()
  ) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("wildtype", "mutant")),
    annotations = "NS",
    y_position = 2090000,
    tip_length = 0.03,
    textsize = 8
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 1)

```
6. Test for difference?
```{r}
# Running stats test
# Check to see if data is normal 
shapiro.test(data$vPFU_cm2) #p value = 0.02 indicating that data is normally distributed
t.test(vPFU_cm2 ~ Genotype, data = data)
```
7. Entrapment efficiency between mutant and wildtype SPO1 using batch culture (currently the second experiment)
```{r}
batch.data <- read_excel("~/GitHub/VirosporeQuant/SPO1_mutant/Data//20260928_1916_spo1mutant_entrapefficiency_batchculture.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
```

8. Calculate virospores and spores per mL and correct for 7 mL of total culture 
Note: 7 mL of total culture for the first batch experiment (20280918 data)
For the 20260928 data it's 8 mL for wild type and 7mL for mutant 
```{r}
batch.data <- batch.data %>%
  mutate(
    spores.ml = (cfu / (cfu.dilution * vol.plated)) /
      if_else(genotype == "wildtype", 8, 7)
  )

format(batch.data$spores.ml, scientific = TRUE)

# Calculate virospores per mL
batch.data <- batch.data %>%
  mutate(
    virospores.ml = (vpfu / (vpfu.dilution * vol.plated)) /
      if_else(genotype == "wildtype", 8, 7)
  )

format(batch.data$virospores.ml, scientific = TRUE)


# # Calculate spores per mL
# batch.data <- batch.data %>%
#   mutate(
#     spores.ml = (cfu / (cfu.dilution * vol.plated)) / 7 #to account for 7mLs of culture that was concentrated to 1ml
#   )
# format(batch.data$spores.ml, scientific = TRUE)
# # Calculate virospores per mL 
# batch.data <- batch.data %>%
#   mutate(
#     virospores.ml = (vpfu / (vpfu.dilution * vol.plated)) / 7 #to account for 7mLs of culture that was concentrated to 1ml
#   )
# format(batch.data$virospores.ml, scientific = TRUE)

# Calculate total spores 
batch.data <- batch.data %>%
  mutate(
    total.spores.ml = spores.ml + virospores.ml
  )

# Calculate entrapment efficiency 
batch.data <- batch.data %>%
  mutate(
    ee = (virospores.ml / total.spores.ml) * 100
  )


```


9. Plot
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Summarize EE by genotype
ee.summary <- batch.data %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    mean.ee = mean(ee, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd.ee = sd(ee, na.rm = TRUE),
    se.ee = sd.ee / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = batch.data,
    aes(
      x = genotype,
      y = ee
    ),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ee.summary,
    aes(
      x = genotype,
      y = mean.ee
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = ee.summary,
    aes(
      x = genotype,
      ymin = mean.ee - se.ee,
      ymax = mean.ee + se.ee
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "SPO1 genotype",
    y = "Entrapment efficiency (%)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Summarize virospores by genotype
viro.summary <- batch.data %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    mean.viro = mean(virospores.ml, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd.viro = sd(virospores.ml, na.rm = TRUE),
    se.viro = sd.viro / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

10. Looking at the data and running stats, replotting with stats in plot
```{r}
batch.data %>%
  select(sample, genotype, ee)

ggplot(batch.data, aes(sample = ee)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ genotype)

# Welch's t test
t.test(
  ee ~ genotype,
  data = batch.data,
  var.equal = FALSE
)

# Replotting and adding stats to figure 
# Plot entrapment efficiency
ee.fig <- ggplot(
  batch.data,
  aes(
    x = genotype,
    y = ee,
    fill = genotype
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = rev(scales::hue_pal()(2))
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.04,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Entrapment efficiency (%)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
  comparisons = list(c("wildtype", "mutant")),
  method = "t.test",
  label = "p.signif",
  label.y = 60,
  symnum.args = list(
    cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
    symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "NS")
  )
) +
  #) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

ee.fig

# Save plot
ggsave(
  "entrapment_efficiency_batchculture0928_wstat.png",
  plot = ee.fig,
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
